{
  "name": "loss_advantage_tanh_pairwise",
  "intuition": "Apply a smooth tanh-based transformation to the advantage gap weighted difference of log probabilities, encouraging margin with bounded gradients and saturating rewards to stabilize training.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscore_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nscaled = tanh(beta * adv_gap * score_diff)\nloss = mean(weight * (1 - scaled))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "mul",
    "sub",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.5)))\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    scaled = ops.tanh(ops.mul(beta, ops.mul(adv_gap, score_diff)))\n    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(weight, ops.sub(ops.ones_like(scaled), scaled))\n    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)\n"
}

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.sum(loss)"

{
  "name": "loss_advantage_tanh_rank_000",
  "intuition": "Transform advantage gap via tanh nonlinearity and apply a differentiable ranking penalty emphasizing margin with smoother gradients.",
  "pseudocode": "normalized_adv = tanh(scale * advantage_gap)\nrank_penalty = relu(margin - normalized_adv)\nloss = mean(weight * rank_penalty)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_ranking",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh_relu",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean",
    "constraint_family": "relu_margin"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "tanh",
    "relu",
    "mean",
    "mul"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    margin = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('margin', 0.5))\n    scaled_adv = ops.tanh(ops.mul(scale, adv_gap))\n    penalty = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin, scaled_adv))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(weight, penalty)\n    else:\n        loss = penalty\n    return loss.mean()"
}

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_advantage_tanh_scaled_weighted",
  "intuition": "Modified the loss to use the sign of the advantage_gap to modulate the tanh-transformed log-probability difference, separating cases where model preference aligns or conflicts with advantage sign. This reduces trivial collapse and enforces stronger signal alignment, improving distinction and addressing similarity by changing the computation combining advantage and log-probs. Kept the weight for pair weighting and mean aggregation.",
  "pseudocode": "adv = batch['advantage_gap']\nlpw = batch['log_prob_w']\nlpl = batch['log_prob_l']\ndiff = lpw - lpl\nscaled_diff = alpha * diff\nsignal = ops.tanh(scaled_diff)\nsign_adv = ops.sign(adv)\nloss = weight * ops.relu(sign_adv * signal * -1 + 1)\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_advantage",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "tanh",

  },
  "operators_used": [

    "mul",
    "sub",

    "sign",
    "relu"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    scaled_diff = ops.mul(alpha, diff)\n    signal = ops.tanh(scaled_diff)\n    sign_adv = ops.sign(adv)\n    # Loss is high when signal disagrees with sign of advantage, zero when aligned\n    loss = ops.mul(weight, ops.relu(ops.sub(1.0, ops.mul(sign_adv, signal))))\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_advantage_rank_gap_softmax_pairwise",
  "intuition": "Shift paradigm to a pairwise rank-gap weighted softmax cross-entropy style loss that uses advantage signals to reweight pairs. This loss computes a softmax probability per pair over winning and losing log-probabilities, weighted by the rank gap transformed into a soft weighting, emphasizing pairs harder to rank correctly.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = abs(delta_rank)
w = softmax_weight(rank_gap)
logits = stack([log_prob_l, log_prob_w], dim=1)
labels = 1 (index of winner)
loss_per_pair = -w * log_softmax(logits)[win_index]
final_loss = mean(loss_per_pair * weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_softmax_cross_entropy",
    "signal_family": "delta_rank",
    "link_family": "softmax_log",
    "agg_family": "weighted_mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "abs",
    "stack",
    "log",
    "exp",
    "mean",
    "mul",
    "div",
    "sub",
    "add"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "delta_rank"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']

    # Compute soft weighting from abs(delta_rank), normalize to [0,1]
    abs_rank = ops.abs(delta_rank)
    max_rank = ops.max(abs_rank)
    # avoid division by zero fallback
    denom = max_rank if max_rank > 0 else 1.0
    w = abs_rank / denom

    # Construct logits for softmax: [log_prob_l, log_prob_w] per pair
    # Index 1 is winner, 0 is loser
    logits = ops.stack([lpl, lpw], dim=1)  # shape (batch_size, 2)

    # Compute log softmax over logits manually: log_softmax(x) = x - log(sum(exp(x)))
    max_logits = ops.max(logits, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    stabilized_logits = ops.sub(logits, max_logits)
    exp_logits = ops.exp(stabilized_logits)
    sum_exp = ops.sum(exp_logits, dim=1, keepdim=True)
    log_softmax = ops.sub(stabilized_logits, ops.log(sum_exp))  # shape (batch_size, 2)

    # Negative log likelihood for winner idx=1
    neg_log_prob_win = -log_softmax[:,1]

    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(w, neg_log_prob_win)
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)

    return ops.mean(loss_weighted)"
}
